title: Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
Who we are and what you’ll do

HOLOPLOT is seeking a decisive, technically strong and business-oriented Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), to lead our 20-person software engineering organization, drive cross-functional delivery, and own the long-term software architecture for our high-performance audio products.

Working closely with engineering leads who focus on deep technical problem-solving and team mentorship, this role leads overall software delivery, strategic technical vision, and cross-departmental alignment.


Main objectives of the role

As Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end delivery of HOLOPLOT’s software ecosystem, spanning embedded and distributed Linux systems, audio DSP, 3D/GPU, C++, Rust and web-based front-end applications, Kubernetes cluster and cloud infrastructure. You will act as the operational bridge between software engineering, hardware development, research, product, customer success teams, and key enterprise clients. You will work closely with the Director of Product for Software as well as the CPO, and report to the CTO.


Your role and responsibilities

  • Strategic Software Vision & Architecture: Own and drive the strategic vision for the technical backbone of the HOLOPLOT product ecosystem. Proactively identify architectural risks and ensure performance and scalability across embedded hardware, audio processing platforms, and user interfaces.

  • Execution & High-Stakes Delivery: Take full accountability for software delivery timeliness, quality, and reliability. Proactively lead critical client-facing missions, OS rollouts, and on-site integration handovers (e.g., venue acceptance testing and integration protocols), including regular international travel

  • High-Performing Mission-Driven Teams: Attract, grow, and retain strong engineering talent to build highly successful, cross-functional product development teams. Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, agency, and innovation that drives high employee engagement, productivity, and strong outcomes for our customers.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive seamless collaboration between Software, Research, Customer Success, Product Management, and external technical partners (such as client IT security and external system integrators). Eliminate inter-departmental friction and establish clear integration pathways.

  • Business-First Leadership: Together with Product, align software priorities and architecture directly with HOLOPLOT’s strategic and commercial objectives. Make decisive, well-reasoned trade-offs under pressure while optimizing engineering output for maximum company value.

  • Operational Leadership & Partnering: Partner with dedicated Engineering Managers and Tech Leads who oversee team culture, individual mentoring, and deeply technical topics. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Focus your impact on operational discipline, accountability, and clear departmental direction.

  • AI Strategy & Development Workflows: Define and execute HOLOPLOT's AI strategy for software development. Integrate AI-assisted engineering tools, automated workflows, and emerging AI technologies into the software development life cycle to elevate team productivity and explore modern product capabilities. 

  • Platform, Quality & Operational Excellence: Ensure high standards of quality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all software solutions. Identify, assess, and mitigate technological risks, including technical debt and platform lifecycle challenges. Define and improve engineering processes, development standards, and tooling to enable predictable, high-quality delivery.

  • Security, Compliance & Risk Management: Drive HOLOPLOT’s technology security strategy, including cybersecurity, data protection, and secure-by-design principles. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, validation/certifications, and regulatory requirements. Ensure systems are resilient, reliable, and fit for production and customer use.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Engineering Leadership: Extensive experience managing software teams of significant size (15-30+ engineers) in complex, multi-disciplinary technology environments

  • Deep-Tech Literacy: Comfortable navigating a highly heterogeneous tech stack encompassing Low-Level/Embedded C++ & Rust, Audio DSP, 3D/GPU rendering, Linux, Kubernetes, NATS, gRPC, JUCE, CI/CD and Web services.

  • Track Record of Ownership: Proven experience driving complex hardware-software product rollouts and managing high-stakes client or partner integrations end-to-end.

  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Strong diplomacy and technical communication skills, with a track record of bridging engineering teams with business, product, research, and client stakeholders.

  • Pragmatic Decision-Making: Ability to operate with high clarity and a steady hand in fast-paced environments, prioritizing long-term product stability over short-term friction.

  • AI-Driven Development Strategy: Demonstrated experience establishing AI-development strategies and driving the practical adoption of AI-assisted software development, LLM tooling, or automated engineering workflows.

  • Audio Software and Hardware Products: Experience with the Pro Audio and Music Technology product space, as both developer and user.


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with the scope and impact of this leadership role, along with perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You'll join an international, open-minded team and work directly with our C-level, engineering and product leads, as well as cross-functional stakeholders in customer success, research, and operations. You'll shape the strategic direction of our software architecture, own high-stakes delivery for cutting-edge audio technology, and drive the AI-assisted development strategy for a 20-person software engineering team, with the autonomy and accountability that comes with a senior leadership mandate.

title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d) mit Fokus UGC & Creator
description:
Wir sind Kaan AI, ein KI-Produkt-Lab aus Nürnberg. Wir bauen und vermarkten unsere eigenen Produkte IntelliSchreiber und KalemiFlow, die zehntausende Studierende nutzen.

In nur zwei Monaten haben wir eines der größten UGC-Teams Deutschlands aufgebaut, heute mit 30 Creatorn. Jetzt starten wir in den USA: zuerst mit 10 Creatorn, dann wachsen wir auf 50.

Du übernimmst das komplette UGC-Team, von Scripts bis Coaching, und verantwortest seine Ergebnisse. Du führst unsere Creator in Deutschland und baust das US-Team mit auf. Du zeigst es vor, statt es nur zu erklären, und stehst deshalb auch selbst vor der Kamera.

Wir starten mit 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche, je nachdem, was für dich passt. Nach 3 Monaten ist die Aufstockung auf Vollzeit geplant.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst unser Creator-Team in Deutschland und den USA: Wochenplanung, Output, Qualität
  • Du entwickelst Hooks, Scripts und Formate und baust eine Bibliothek aus dem, was nachweislich performt
  • Du testest neue Ideen über viele Creator gleichzeitig und entscheidest anhand von Views, Retention und Conversions
  • Du coachst jede einzelne Person im Team, bis ihre Videos performen
  • Du drehst neue Formate zuerst selbst, bevor das Team sie übernimmt
  • Du baust das US-Team von 10 auf 50 Creator mit auf: finden, testen, onboarden
  • Du analysierst, was die besten UGC-Teams und Wettbewerber machen, auch mit unseren eigenen KI-Tools

Qualifikation

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge mit Short-Form-Content: eigene oder betreute Videos mit echter Reichweite
  • Erfahrung im Creator-Management, in einer UGC- oder Social-Agentur oder im Social-Team einer Brand
  • Du stehst gern vor der Kamera und kannst Videos drehen, die funktionieren
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen aus Daten und erkennst in Sekunden, warum ein Video floppt
  • Du kannst Menschen führen und motivieren und gibst klares, direktes Feedback
  • Du arbeitest schnell, nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich und denkst trotzdem selbst
  • Fließendes Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch. Wegen der US-Zeitzonen liegen einzelne Calls am Abend
  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland
  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit dem US-Markt oder mit Studierenden als Zielgruppe

Benefits

  • Ownership: Du verantwortest eines der größten UGC-Teams Deutschlands und den Aufbau in den USA
  • Vollzeit nach 3 Monaten geplant
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer, schnelle Entscheidungen, keine Abstimmungsschleifen
  • Remote-first: Wir stellen Leute ein, denen wir vertrauen. Arbeite von zu Hause, in unserem Büro im Nürnberger Osten (zehn Minuten vom Hauptbahnhof) oder unterwegs auf Reisen. Wo und wann du arbeitest, ist uns egal, solange die Ergebnisse stimmen
  • Du arbeitest für unsere eigenen KI-Produkte mit zehntausenden Nutzern, nicht für Kunden
  • Festgehalt plus Bonus, der mit der Performance wächst, die du in unser Team bringst. Auf Vollzeit gerechnet sind das je nach Performance 3.000 bis 8.000 € brutto im Monat
  • MacBook, iPhone und alles, was du zum Drehen brauchst
  • 30 € monatlicher Zuschuss für Fitness und Gesundheit
  • Essenszuschuss an den Tagen, an denen du bei uns im Büro in Nürnberg arbeitest
  • Optional nach der Probezeit: ein Firmenwagen per Gehaltsumwandlung, den wir mit 300 € im Monat bezuschussen

So arbeiten wir

Tempo. In allem. Wir arbeiten schnell, entscheiden schnell und liefern schnell. Was andere Teams in Wochen schaffen, machen wir in Tagen. Lieber heute eine gute Entscheidung als nächste Woche eine perfekte. Genau dieses Tempo erwarten wir von dir.

Ownership: Du denkst, die KI hilft. Wir nutzen KI überall, wo sie uns schneller macht. Wir suchen aber niemanden, der Aufgaben in ChatGPT kopiert und hofft, dass schon etwas Gutes rauskommt. Du denkst selbst, hinterfragst Ergebnisse und treibst dein Thema bis zum Ergebnis. Die KI ist dein Werkzeug, am Steuer sitzt du.

Wir gewinnen durch Tests. Wir schauen genau hin, was die besten UGC-Teams machen, und lernen daraus. Am Ende entscheidet aber nicht das Bauchgefühl, sondern der Test: Idee, schnell raus, messen, behalten, was funktioniert. Wer mehr und schneller testet, gewinnt.

Laut statt brav. Unser Marketing ist frech, zugespitzt und auch mal reißerisch. Wir brechen die ungeschriebenen Regeln, an die sich andere in der Branche halten, und gehen weiter als die anderen. Das musst du mögen und auf unserem Level mitspielen, auch vor der Kamera.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder, noch besser, ein paar Links zu Videos von dir, die richtig gut performt haben. Nach einem kurzen Gespräch arbeitest du eine Woche bezahlt bei uns mit. So sehen beide Seiten schnell, ob es passt.

title: Certification Lead – BESS, Power Electronics & Digital Systems (m/f/d)
description:
Your Role

At STABL Energy, we’re building the next generation of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), combining battery technology, advanced power electronics, embedded controls, and cloud-connected software.

In this role, you will own certification and product compliance across our complete BESS system architecture – from batteries and inverter technology to control systems and cloud connectivity. Your mission

  • Develop certification strategies, compliance plans, and verification requirements for new products and product variants.
  • Coordinate testing and certification activities with external laboratories, certification bodies, and technical experts.
  • Review system architectures, specifications, risk assessments, test plans, and technical documentation from a compliance perspective.
  • Ensure product cybersecurity requirements are considered in embedded software, communication interfaces, remote connectivity, and cloud services.
  • Identify certification and compliance risks early and drive mitigation measures together with Engineering.
  • Assess design, software, and component changes regarding their impact on existing certifications and conformity.
  • Monitor changes in relevant standards and legislation and assess their impact on our products.

Your profile

Must-Have:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Energy Technology, Mechatronics, or a comparable technical field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in product certification, product compliance, testing, or systems engineering.

  • Good understanding of electrical safety, EMC, system safety, testing, and technical product documentation.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity and compliance requirements for connected industrial products.

Nice-to-Have:

    • Cybersecurity & connected products: IEC 62443 series
    • Cloud security: ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27017
  • Experience with relevant EU product legislation, including the EU Battery Regulation, Low Voltage Directive, EMC Directive, and Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
  • Experience with CE conformity assessment, technical documentation, and product risk assessments.
  • Experience supporting certification across multiple European markets.

title: Head of Third Party Management
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

Allica works with 300+ third parties that deliver services our customers and colleagues depend on. Managing the risk, resilience and value of those arrangements is a business need, and as a regulated bank they are also subject to demanding and evolving supervisory expectations.

This role designs, owns and drives adoption of the end-to-end third-party management framework (sourcing, contracting, onboarding, ongoing assurance and exit), holds the business accountable for operating it consistently, and is accountable both for third-party risk being understood, controlled and held within appetite, and for the Bank meeting its regulatory obligations for its third-party arrangements.

The mandate is Bank-wide: this role sets the standard, owns the tooling and holds the data, and is accountable for the framework delivering control in practice. Accountability for each individual supplier relationship sits with the relevant business or service owner. It measures adherence and works alongside owners to resolve what is outstanding, escalating where that support has not moved the position. Its authority comes from the framework it owns, the governance it runs and the evidence it brings, backed by clarity, credibility and persistence.

Principal Accountabilities

Strategy and framework

• A coherent Bank-wide operating model. Set the procurement and third-party management strategy, governance and roadmap so that commercial decision-making and risk management operate as one joined-up discipline.

• Proportionate control throughout the lifecycle. Own policies, standards and control requirements that apply greater scrutiny where risk and materiality are higher, while keeping the process practical for lower-risk arrangements.

• Clear and exercised accountability. Define decision rights across supplier owners and the relevant first-line functions, secure approval through the appropriate governance bodies, and ensure responsibilities are understood, exercised and evidenced in practice, intervening directly where they are not.

• A function that keeps pace with the Bank. Translate business growth, regulatory change, new technology and lessons from incidents or assurance into a prioritised improvement roadmap supported by evidence of control effectiveness.

Procurement and commercial management

• Commercial value that is visible and evidenced. Create a consistent approach to demand, sourcing, benchmarking, negotiation, renewal and savings validation so the Bank can demonstrate the value achieved from third-party spend.

• Stronger outcomes from material negotiations. Lead or support significant contracts and renewals, bringing market insight, leverage and disciplined trade-offs while protecting service quality, resilience, customer outcomes and the control environment.

• Contracts that work as control instruments. Working with Legal, ensure contractual positions reflect the nature and materiality of the arrangement, including service levels, information and audit rights, data and security, subcontracting, business continuity, termination and exit requirements. Set those requirements before negotiation opens, and escalate through governance where the terms achievable fall short of risk appetite.

• Fewer avoidable last-minute decisions. Maintain a forward view of procurement activity, expiries and renewals so the Bank has time to test the market, remediate control gaps or execute an alternative strategy.

Third-party risk and governance

• Ensure the third-party register is accurate, current and supported by consistent materiality and risk assessments, with regulatory notifications made when required.

• Intragroup arrangements held to the same standard. Own the framework's application to intragroup and affiliate arrangements, ensuring they are recorded, assessed for materiality and risk, supported by documented agreements and service expectations, and covered by proportionate exit and resilience planning. Group ownership does not reduce the Bank's accountability for the service or the risk.

• Ongoing assurance that reflects actual risk. Set and oversee the cadence for due diligence refresh, service and risk review, control attestation and remediation, with frequency and depth driven by tier, materiality and emerging concerns.

• Credible exit capability. Require exit plans, prioritised by tier and importance to the Bank's important business services, and work with supplier owners and Operational Resilience to ensure the most important plans are tested and actionable.

• Portfolio-level visibility of concentration and dependency risk. Maintain a current view of exposure across providers, services, technologies, locations, fourth parties and subcontracting chains, and escalate concentrations that exceed or threaten risk appetite.

• Continuous supervisory readiness, owned end to end. Ensure the Bank can respond quickly and credibly to PRA, FCA, Internal Audit and Board requests with traceable data, clear ownership, evidence of challenge and an accurate account of outstanding risk.

Business owner enablement, oversight and assurance

• Enablement that is hands-on. Provide practical training, guidance and advice that make the expected standard clear at each stage of the third-party lifecycle, and work directly with owners on complex, material or high-risk arrangements.

• Adherence that is measured and visible. Define measures of completion, timeliness and quality; make performance transparent by owner and business area; and distinguish isolated delay from systemic control weakness.

• Exceptions that lead to action. Follow through on overdue assessments, attestations and remediation, helping owners remove blockers and escalating constructively when risk, evidence or progress remains insufficient. Ownership runs until the gap is closed, not until it has been raised.

• A rising baseline of capability across the Bank. Use recurring issues, quality reviews and feedback from supplier owners to simplify the process and target capability-building where it will have the greatest impact.

Data, tooling and automation

• One trusted source of third-party information. Establish clear data ownership, definitions and quality controls so executive, Board and regulatory reporting can be produced from governed data rather than reconciled spreadsheets.

• A platform that supports the operating model and reduces manual effort. Own the third-party management platform, complete a fitness-for-purpose assessment in time to inform its renewal decision, and maintain a roadmap that automates intake, evidence collection, reminders, register maintenance, workflow and reporting where this improves control and user experience.

• Decision-quality management information. Give executives and the Board a concise view of material arrangements, risk exposure, control adherence, concentration, incidents, remediation, renewals, spend, savings and forward priorities.

Personal Attributes & Experience

• Senior third-party management, vendor management or procurement leadership experience within a UK regulated financial services firm

• Working knowledge of PRA SS2/21 and SYSC 8 Outsourcing, demonstrated through practical application rather than familiarity with the text

• A track record of negotiating and contracting significant technology and outsourced service agreements

• Experience designing or materially improving a supplier segmentation and materiality assessment approach

• Evidence of driving adoption of a process across an organisation without direct authority over the people operating it

• Experience leading a small team

• A metric-driven approach, defining what will be measured before designing the process that produces it

• Technical fluency and comfort with data tooling and workflow automation, with the judgement to see where technology can remove manual effort and the credibility to specify and drive that change

title: Senior IC PDK Development Engineer
description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing start-up based in London. We are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. We operate out of state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities in Islington and bring together an outstanding interdisciplinary team spanning quantum physics to IC design. 


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC, and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We are backed by a world-class group of investors including Bosch Ventures, Porsche SE, Sony Innovation Fund, Oxford Science Enterprises, INKEF Capital, and Octopus Ventures. 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians, and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working closely together to maximize our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Sydney, San Sebastian & Maryland (US) with our main hub in our Islington lab. 


Functions of the Role

The primary function of this position will be to architect, build, and maintain our custom process design kits (PDKs) and physical verification enablements. In this role, you will sit within the IC Design team, serving as the critical bridge between foundry technologies, custom cryogenic silicon devices, and our circuit design group.
You will create custom PDK components from scratch and enable novel silicon spin-qubit and cryo-CMOS circuit design methodologies. No prior background in quantum physics is required.

  • Development of custom PDK elements from scratch, including Schematic symbols, Layout SKILL PCells, and custom DRC and LVS decks.
  • Development, qualification, and maintenance of custom Calibre SVRF rule decks tailored for non-standard layout constraints and cryogenic CMOS layout considerations.
  • Integrate tier-1 foundry PDKs into Cadence Virtuoso, creating customized library extensions, layer maps, and device callbacks.
  • Work closely with IC designers and layout engineers to establish best practices for physical verification and layout automation.
  • Document own work for peer review and evaluate the layout and enablement work of other team members.


Experience - Essentials

  • Industry degree qualification in Electronic Engineering, IC Layout, Computer Science, or a related physical science/engineering field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in IC PDK Development and PDK enablement flow management.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Cadence SKILL PCell coding and Virtuoso PDK customization.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Siemens Calibre Physical Verification tools and SVRF Rule writing (specifically for DRC and LVS decks).
  • Proven hands-on experience in complex DRC and LVS error debugging within analog/mixed-signal or custom digital layout environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of self-management, self-motivation, and willingness to engage actively in peer code and layout reviews.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary physics and IC engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

  • Demonstrated experience with advanced deep-submicron CMOS nodes (40nm, 28nm, or below), including familiarity with layout-dependent effects (LOD, WPE, OSE, etc.).
  • Expert knowledge of the Cadence Virtuoso Design Environment and Cadence SKILL / SKILL++ programming.
  • Expert knowledge of the Siemens Calibre Physical Verification Environment.
  • Familiarity with MOSFET device modeling integration (e.g., BSIM, Verilog-A) or cryogenic device enablement. 
  • General awareness or curiosity regarding semiconductor quantum dots or silicon spin qubit fundamentals. 


Benefits

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Life Assurance
  • Cycle-to-work Scheme
  • Flexible working

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

About the role

This role is for someone wanting to start a career in operations within a financial services firm. You'll join as a Graduate focused on working complaints and train to become a fully competent Complaints Officer, investigating and resolving our more complex customer interactions across loans, cards and auto-finance. A critical role to help the business understand how it can serve customers better.

This is a casework role. From early on you will hold your own caseload, speak to customers directly, make decisions on whether we got it right, and put things right where we didn't. You will be supported through structured training, coaching and quality feedback as you develop in the role

Some of the areas you'll delve into are:

  • The regulatory framework for complaints: FCA regulation, the DISP rules, Consumer Duty, and how the guidance is applied to real cases.

  • Investigation technique: gathering evidence, interrogating system records and call recordings, and testing what actually happened against what should have happened.

  • Decision making and redress: reaching fair and objective outcomes, and calculating and explaining any compensation due.

  • Customer communication: writing final response letters that break complex issues down into plain English.

  • The Financial Ombudsman Service: how cases are referred, how FOS reaches its view, and how we apply those learnings to future cases.

  • Root cause and feedback: spotting the product and process failures behind complaints and feeding them back to frontline and product teams.

Reporting to a Complaints Manager within the Operations Team, you will be responsible for a live caseload and for the quality of the decisions you make on it.

No prior complaints experience needed, we care about how you think, not what you already know. This role requires an ability to learn quickly, work to deadlines and support our customers effectively.

Your team's objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and to reaching the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we evolve as a business. The team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insight back into the business so we can improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers and therefore for us as a business has never been more important than now, as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

What you'll be doing

  • Investigating and resolving complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, taking each case on its own merits

  • Self-managing a varied and increasingly complex caseload: prioritising cases, choosing the best contact mechanism for each customer, and working efficiently enough to meet our KPI minimum standards

  • Communicating with complainants in writing and by phone — managing expectations, handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism, and finding solutions to the issues raised

  • Writing professional final response letters that set out our decision, our rationale and the customer's right to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • Following our complaint handling standards and keeping clear records, making sure every decision is backed by demonstrable evidence and a documented rationale

  • Working to resolve complaints without the customer needing to refer to FOS, and applying the learnings from both internal and FOS outcomes to future cases

  • Feeding back to frontline and product teams on the product and process improvements your cases surface, across Operations and the wider Lendable business

  • Keeping your knowledge of Lendable's products current through effective use and review of our policies, procedures and business tools

  • Turning your hand to other areas of operational need as the business requires

What we're looking for

  • Educated to degree level

  • Exceptional written communication - you can structure an argument and explain a complex decision clearly to someone who is not an expert

  • An aptitude for investigation, analysis, problem-solving and dispute resolution

  • Strong organisation and self-management - you can hold a caseload, prioritise it and work to deadlines without being chased

  • Sound judgment and a sound moral compass: willing to speak up to make sure good customer outcomes stay at the heart of what we do

  • Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment

  • A willingness to learn FCA regulation and the DISP complaint handling rules and guidance

The interview process

We're not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we'd expect:

  • A 15 minute cognitive assessment

  • A quick phone call with one of the Talent team

  • An onsite assessment centre with a role focus and a final stage interview with the Complaints Management team to discuss your fit and capability for the role.

Life at Lendable

We're hiring two Senior Quality Engineers to set up a Quality Engineering department at Lendable alongside a new Head of Quality.

At Lendable we already have a number of profitable, award winning credit products. They have a good automated quality story. However, as our customer base has grown into the millions we need to keep evolving to keep the quality bar high. Advances in AI engineering also have enabled us to ship faster, but we need to ensure we are not regressing on our quality metrics.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - AI Agents, test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers. You won't be executing tests by hand. You'll work cross-functionally with software engineers, product and design. Quality is a team-level responsibility and your job is to work with teams to enable them to improve their quality processes by hands-on collaboration.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

What you'll be doing

Enable teams to keep the quality bar high

  • Rotating around different product teams for short periods to level up quality

  • Define and evolve the pragmatic test pyramid for our products - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where testing belongs in faster layers (unit and component tests)

  • Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across our products

  • Devise and set up performance benchmarks to ensure critical parts of our systems don't regress

Bring AI testing into the SDLC

  • Speed up our SDLC by building agents that exploratory test changes and catch issues before they get to production

  • Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes

  • Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A test suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on

Build reliable E2E automation

  • Discover gaps in testing and help teams build comprehensive suites

  • Get test environments and data fixtures to a level where they are easy to use and reliable

  • Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green

Prevent defects, not just catch them

  • Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written

  • Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact

  • Ensure teams have Service Level Objectives set up and are achieving them

  • Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call

What we're looking for

Essential

  • 5+ years in quality engineering or test automation, with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests

  • Experience working in a scaled engineering environment with multiple teams pulling in different directions and priorities, and know how to navigate that to drive quality improvements across them

  • Hands-on coding experience of writing test code, frameworks, CI pipelines and other helper scripts. You know what a good test codebase looks like and you constantly improve it

  • API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy

  • Have set up and used Service Level Objectives to define a contract of system reliability with stakeholders, and driven measurable improvements against them

  • Native AI-assisted working style. You can describe projects where AI meaningfully changed how you worked - test authoring, failure triage, coverage analysis - and where you decided it wasn't the right tool

  • Coaching other disciplines in quality. You evangelise quality practices and get others on board to solve quality problems together

  • Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control

  • Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator, able to chase things down when blocked

  • Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting)

  • Can point to 3-4 projects where you moved the needle on quality - for example improving SLO coverage or reducing incident rate - and can speak to the measurable impact of each

Nice to have

  • Have worked with an incident management process to root cause issues with engineers and devise meaningful quality improvements as a result

  • Experience in PHP, Kotlin or Typescript

  • Experience in financial services (retail or institutional) or other regulated environments

Our tech stack

Frontend: TypeScript, React, React Native

Backend: PHP (Symfony), Kotlin, AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes

Testing: PHPUnit, Behat, JUnit, Kotest, Jest, Maestro, K6

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana

Why join?

  • See your work matter: Our products are used by millions of customers - the quality bar you help set has a direct line to customer trust and company revenue

  • High impact: You'll decide where and how to engage across teams to move quality forward, working hands-on rather than through process layers

title: Senior software engineer - EU squad
description:
Hybrid working based at one of our offices in London, Bath or Edinburgh. Your contract will be hybrid, although we don’t currently require a set number of office days. We support flexible working and trust teams to agree how and where they work best, taking a pragmatic approach based on the needs of the role and team.

 

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

 

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

Our culture:

Never settle – We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.

Take ownership - We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long-term scalability.

Be generous & candid - We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

 

Our engineering ways of working:

  • Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud & Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.

  • The squads are intentionally small and cross-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.

  • We operate in a build-and-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.

  • Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in TypeScript and Node.js, with MongoDB as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.

  • Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.

  • We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

 
 

The role

As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using Typescript and Node.js. You play a key role in our software development and have a hands-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go-to’ person for queries.

 

On a typical day you will…

  • Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer-facing and operations teams

  • Design, implement and operate your services within your domain

  • Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements

  • Maintain and extend documentation for your services

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate

  • Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers

  • Communicate with non-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

 

What you need…

  • To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build-and-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.

  • We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.

  • Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.

  • Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long-term scalability.

  • Experience building financial systems with multi-region, multi-currency or trading-related complexity would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.

  • Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high-quality, standards-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.

  • Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.

  • Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.

  • Willing to be on-call for your services.

 

Core technical skills you must have:

  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js, specifically TypeScript

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services

  • Experience with Serverless products

  • Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB

  • Experience mentoring engineers

  • Experience leading technical delivery in a build-and-run engineering model

  • Experience in a structured on-call process and incident management

  • Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

 

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

 

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

Base salary based on experience and skills demonstrated during our assessment phase

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

title: Account Executive France
description:
Are you prepared to fuel the growth of an exciting scale-up that's transforming the logistics industry? Do you thrive on building strategic relationships and close deals? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Logistics? Maybe not what you dreamed of as a kid. But building a fast-growing international SaaS scale-up that’s transforming how some of the world’s largest industrial companies operate? That’s a different story.

 

Peripass is a tech company at heart. We build software that digitises and automates complex logistics environments for companies like Bridgestone, Alpro and Arcelor Mittal. These companies have hundreds of trucks (un)loading every month, and our SaaS platform helps them orchestrate that whole process. Peripass is a high-impact SaaS platform used in international enterprise environments.

Want to be part of this adventure? As an Account Executive France within the Sales Team:

  • Launch new product offer: you are mainly responsible for selling remote our newest product in the French market.

  • Pipeline Creation and Management: Independently build and manage a robust sales pipeline with full-cycle ownership, from lead generation to closing. This includes identifying prospects, qualifying leads, and developing opportunities.

  • Active Prospecting and Market Expansion: Engage in targeted outreach to win new customers ("logos") across four different industries, leveraging a strategic and personalized approach.

  • Pipeline Momentum and Sales Velocity: Proactively collaborate with internal stakeholders and customer champions to maintain momentum, reduce sales cycles, and improve win rates. This involves consistent follow-ups, addressing blockers, and aligning on goals.

  • Engagement and Time Savings Case Development: Conduct virtual meetings with prospects in your designated market. Work closely with technical pre-sales teams to co-develop compelling business cases that align with the customer’s objectives and expectations.

  • Deal Negotiation and Closing: Take commercial leadership in deal negotiation and closure, ensuring alignment with the prospect’s needs while achieving company revenue and margin goals. This includes handling objections and finalizing contracts.

  • About every 6 weeks, you'll come and check up on how your colleagues are doing in the Ghent HQ. To get you fully acquainted with your colleagues, you'll also get an in-depth onboarding at our HQ during your first 2 weeks

  • Steven, our Sales Director has already been around the block in SaaS sales. You'll report directly to him and he's looking forward to coaching you extensively, so you can make your career at Peripass a real success story.


What we offer:

  • Win big in a booming market  => Be part of a fast-scaling SaaS company revolutionizing yard management in logistics. Huge potential, untapped opportunities, and the chance to make a real impact in France.

  • Uncapped earning potential => A competitive salary with a commission plan that truly rewards success. The more you close, the more you earn.

  • Ownership & freedom => Take charge of your pipeline and strategy. We trust you to drive results, with the flexibility to work how and where you perform best.

  • Backed by a winning team => From marketing to pre-sales and customer success, you’ll have a strong team behind you, helping you close and grow accounts.


What you’ll bring:

  • A solid experience in selling enterprise SaaS solutions. 

  • Ideally you have experience in the Logistics & Supply Chain sector.  

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills. 

  • Strong stakeholder management to manage complex DMU's and land sales processes in international corporate environments.

  • A partnership and win-win mindset while selling our solution.

  • A great sense of initiative and perseverance, since you'll be opening up a new market. 

  • You speak and write French on a native level. You can have a professional conversation in English since that is our internal language.

Your focus will be on developing and optimizing model-serving architectures for advanced AI systems across a range of hardware environments.
You will tackle challenges involving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability, including deployment on resource-constrained mobile and edge devices.
The role combines hands-on research with low-level engineering, giving you the opportunity to develop novel inference strategies and GPU kernels.
You will work with complex architectures spanning text, image, audio, diffusion models, and vision transformers.
Your work will involve rigorous benchmarking, production testing, and iterative optimization to translate research into measurable performance improvements.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly technical, remote environment focused on pushing the boundaries of efficient AI systems.

  • Design and deploy advanced model-serving architectures optimized for high throughput, low latency, and efficient memory utilization.
  • Develop inference pipelines capable of operating effectively across diverse environments, including resource-constrained mobile devices and edge platforms.
  • Establish clear performance targets covering response latency, token generation speed, throughput, memory footprint, and reliability.
  • Build and execute controlled inference benchmarks in simulated and production environments, tracking latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates.
  • Create and maintain representative datasets and simulation scenarios for evaluating model performance under real-world and resource-constrained conditions.
  • Identify computational and memory bottlenecks across inference pipelines and implement solutions involving batching, networking, memory management, and other system-level optimizations.

    • Requirements:

    • Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; a PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related discipline is highly relevant, particularly with a strong AI research track record and publications at leading conferences.
    • Proven expertise in Metal Shading Language (MSL), including the ability to write custom compute shaders from scratch.

    • Deep understanding of the mathematical foundations and architecture of diffusion models and Vision Transformers.
    • Familiarity with modern inference optimization techniques including pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV Cache optimization, and speculative decoding such as EAGLE.

title: Customer Support Specialist - CDD 6 mois
description:
Rejoignez l’aventure Joivy : L’art de vivre (et de travailler) à l’européenne !

Joivy est bien plus qu’une plateforme immobilière : c’est le premier écosystème résidentiel d’Europe conçu pour accompagner chaque étape de la vie. Du coliving au design soigné aux escapades en location de vacances, en passant par le logement étudiant ou des espaces de coworking inspirants, nous créons des lieux où l’on se sent immédiatement chez soi.

Un écosystème innovant pour tous les besoins Joivy est l’alliance stratégique de pionniers tels que DoveVivo, Altido, Chez-Nestor et Open. Ensemble, nous redéfinissons les codes du marché :

  • Pour nos résidents : Une offre flexible (colocations, studios, villas) pour des séjours de toutes durées, portée par une expérience numérique fluide.

  • Pour nos partenaires : Un accompagnement premium pour les propriétaires et investisseurs, de la gestion d'actifs à la transformation immobilière grâce à l'intelligence artificielle et des outils d'analyse de pointe.

L’aventure Joivy en quelques chiffres clés :

  • Une expertise unique : 450 talents passionnés de plus de 30 nationalités (moyenne d’âge de 32 ans).

  • Une présence XXL : 50 destinations à travers 7 pays (Italie, Espagne, France, Portugal, UK, Luxembourg et Bulgarie).

  • Une force de frappe globale : Près de 2 000 propriétaires accompagnés et plus de 150 000 utilisateurs conquis.

Au sein de l'équipe Customer Care (Service Client), votre objectif est de maximiser la satisfaction client. Vous êtes le point de contact principal des clients tout au long de leur parcours, depuis le jour de leur réservation jusqu'au remboursement de leur dépôt de garantie après leur départ. Vous assistez les clients pour l'ensemble de leurs problématiques, qu'elles soient administratives ou financières, y compris pour la maintenance de leur appartement. La maîtrise des langues est essentielle, car une part importante de nos clients est internationale. La majorité de l'équipe est basée à Lyon, à l'exception d'une personne basée à Paris, et nous opérons à distance sur l'ensemble de nos villes en France.

Vos missions :

  • Gérer la relation et accompagner le client à distance via Zendesk tout au long de son expérience de coliving, de l'entrée à la sortie du logement : rédaction du bail, vérification des documents, organisation des états des lieux d'entrée (check-in) et de sortie (check-out), comparaison des états des lieux, remboursement des dépôts de garantie.

  • Créer le dossier client numérique et le mettre à jour tout au long de son parcours.

  • Gérer à distance les conflits entre colivers (colocataires) et les litiges clients, dans le meilleur intérêt de l'entreprise et du client.

  • Recouvrer les impayés de loyers et les différents frais auprès des clients par e-mail et par téléphone.

  • Résoudre les problèmes techniques (paiement, accès au compte client, etc.) rencontrés par le client en mobilisant les ressources de l'entreprise.

  • Qualifier, transmettre et suivre en interne l'exécution des interventions techniques dans les appartements, et en informer le client. Assurer le suivi auprès des locataires concernant les interventions en cours ou à venir.

  • Qualifier et répondre aux différents besoins et demandes des clients par e-mail, chat ou WhatsApp, dans les délais définis par l'entreprise.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des pratiques et processus de Customer Happiness afin d'accroître la satisfaction client et d'optimiser les coûts opérationnels des logements en coliving : remonter les bugs à l'équipe technique, améliorer les flux de travail (workflows), numériser les processus, etc.


Ton profil se distingue par :

  • Diplômé(e) en gestion, commerce ou relations clients, tu justifies idéalement d'une première expérience réussie dans le secteur immobilier (gestion locative, transaction ou property management).

  • Tu es un(e) communicant(e) hors pair. Tu sais allier empathie, clarté et fermeté pour instaurer un climat de confiance tout en défendant les intérêts de Joivy et de ses partenaires.

  • Véritable "digital native", tu maîtrises les outils collaboratifs modernes (type Zendesk, CRM) et tu es parfaitement à l'aise avec les modes de travail hybrides ou à distance.

  • Tu ne te contentes pas de gérer l'existant. Ta proactivité et ton esprit d'analyse te poussent à identifier des axes d'amélioration et à proposer des solutions innovantes pour optimiser nos processus.

Parce que nous savons que nos experts sont notre meilleure ressource, nous vous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant :

  • Intégrez une communauté soudée et ultra-motivée pour relever des défis collectifs !

  • On ne s'ennuie jamais chez nous ! Entre nos afterwork, nos chasses aux œufs mémorables, ou nos incontournables petits-déjeuners du mardi, la convivialité est sacrée.

  • La mutuelle performante de Swisslife avec de fortes garanties pour prendre soin de vous et de vos proches.

  • Des tickets restaurant de 9 €/jour (via carte Edenred), prise à 50% du titre de transport.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.


Your Impact

Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.


Your Profile

  • 5 years  experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D  and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.


Bonus Points
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

    • What We Offer

    • The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

    • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.

    • The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio.

    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.


What you will do

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead


    • Experience and qualifications

    Experience & Technical Acumen

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

  • Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

  • Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

  • Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. title: Network Developer
description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

  • Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

  • Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

  • Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

  • Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

  • Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

  • Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

  • Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

  • Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

  • Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

  • Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

  • You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

  • You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

  • AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

  • You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

  • A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

  • Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

  • Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

  • 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

  • Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

  • Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

  • DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)
